description: Fixed education, experience and earnings with twelve missing experience reports to teach common-sample comparison.
source: Original synthetic OpenEconometrics teaching data; not real observations.

columns.name: worker_id
columns.description: Worker identifier from 1 to 600; preserves the selected workers.

columns.name: education
columns.description: Completed years of schooling from 10 through 18.

columns.name: experience
columns.description: Work experience between 2 and 40 years when observed.
columns.missing: Twelve blank reports for worker IDs 1, 51, 101, 151, 201, 251, 301, 351, 401, 451, 501 and 551; retain the blanks in the workbook, then select a common complete-case sample before both primary fits.

columns.name: log_earnings
columns.description: Natural logarithm of hourly earnings measured in the stated currency unit.
columns.unit: Natural log of hypothetical currency units per hour
